headline: 19 Sui object/package IDs catalogued from docs, GitHub README and SDK pages; no admin/multisig/AdminCap holder found and no on-chain reads possible.

findings.text: No Sui explorer name-tag search was possible. Sui explorers are not on the allowed explorer list, and my one attempt to fetch a Suivision object page was rejected. No addresses were sourced from explorer tags.

The docs site (haedal-protocol.gitbook.io) has no dedicated 'deployed contracts' page in its llms.txt index. The only fetched address list is the HAEDAL tokenomics page, which gives the HAEDAL coin type and 13 distinct vesting addresses (investors, team, ecosystem incentives).

The docs audit page only links to https://github.com/haedallsd/audit-report. I did not fetch that repo, so no audit scope addresses or auditor names were extracted. A CertiK Skynet search snippet mentions audited files admin_cap.move and errors.move, which is snippet-only.

The haedallsd/haedal-protocol-interface README (read through a search result body, not a direct fetch) lists the mainnet original packageId, the latest upgraded packageId and the Staking object ID. No pinned commit SHA was available. A third-party Navi SDK doc page lists a default Haedal packageId and the haSUI coin type.
Only one chain is listed (Sui). Addresses were found on Sui only; the Sui network gives no cross-chain deployments to enumerate for the pinned chain list.
No factory contracts were identified. Sui is not a supported chainId for the defipunkd read API, so no enumeration was performed.

Roles were assigned tentatively using the controlled vocabulary: 2 packages (other), 1 Staking shared object (vault), 2 tokens, 1 third-party-sourced package (other) and 13 vesting recipients (other). All actor_class values are unknown because bytecode and object ownership were not read.

Every address in admin_addresses traces to a fetched docs page or a search-returned page body listed in evidence[]. Snippet-only sightings (BSC HAEDAL token, vesting address in a stale snippet) are in unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice, so grade is unknown. I walked the docs llms.txt, the tokenomics page, the audit page, and GitHub README and SDK pages (via search result bodies), and catalogued 19 Sui IDs. The admin/upgrade-cap/multisig surface was not found and the fetch budget blocked the on-chain and audit-repo reads.

evidence.shows: Probe of protocol.website: the fetch returned only page title/meta description (stake SUI, get haSUI) and no body content or addresses.
Docs index. Lists pages for haSUI, haWAL, HMM (noted as deprecated since August 2026), HAEDAL/veHAEDAL tokenomics, Audit and Bug Bounty. It has no dedicated deployed-contracts page.

HAEDAL coin type on Sui: 0x3a304c7feba2d819ea57c3542d68439ca2c386ba02159c740f7b406e592c62ea::haedal::HAEDAL. Also lists future vesting addresses: investors 0x84c3369cbf6e576b8f7d370a2e61f359c12ecf058705012113def5e0d60951cd and 0xe4a4d301b3ff2b04f562c2ad422b10b384fee60a707832a1ae20c783f738d433; team 0x84c3...51cd (same as the first investor address); and 11 ecosystem-incentive addresses.
The audit page only points to the audit report repo https://github.com/haedallsd/audit-report, which was not fetched.

Read via web_search result body (not a direct fetch). Mainnet original packageId 0xbde4ba4c2e274a60ce15c1cfff9e5c42e41654ac8b6d906a57efa4bd3c29f47d, latest upgraded packageId 0x126e4cfb051cad744706df590ec399e8c02b6feae195c35b8b496280d5442a62, and Staking object id 0x47b224762220393057ebf4f70501b6e657c3e56684737568439a04f80849b2ca. Testnet IDs are also listed. The wrapper SuiSystemState is 0x5.

Read via web_search result body. Third-party Navi SDK default Haedal packageId 0x19e6ea7f5ced4f090e20da794cc80349a03e638940ddb95155a4e301f5f4967c. The haSUI coin type is 0xbde4ba4c2e274a60ce15c1cfff9e5c42e41654ac8b6d906a57efa4bd3c29f47d::hasui::HASUI, which matches the original package ID in the README.
Read via web_search result body. The GitHub org haedallsd hosts haedal-protocol-interface (Move, updated Apr 1, 2026).

Read via web_search result body. haWAL interface repo describing request_stake_coin, request_withdraw_stake and withdraw_stake, which take a Walrus WalStaking, a haWAL Staking object and a system object. No concrete IDs appeared in the snippet.

unknowns: D1: Sui explorer name-tag search not performed. Suivision and Suiscan are not on the allowed explorer list, and my one attempted fetch of a Suivision object page was rejected. No search for 'Haedal' on a Sui explorer was run.

D1-offchain: attempted on-chain fetch https://suivision.xyz/object/0x47b224762220393057ebf4f70501b6e657c3e56684737568439a04f80849b2ca failed (rejected / no fetch budget). Sui (not a supported chainId) is unreadable through the defipunkd API, so no on-chain state was read this run.

D2: no dedicated 'deployed contracts' page found in the docs index. Docs pages for haSUI, haWAL, veHAEDAL, HMM, Links and FAQ were not fetched, so addresses for haWAL WalStaking, veHAEDAL, HMM and the protocol admin/treasury may exist there. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc is left null.

D3: audit repo https://github.com/haedallsd/audit-report was named by the docs but not fetched. Auditors, dates and in-scope addresses are unknown. A CertiK Skynet snippet mentions admin_cap.move, but that is snippet-only and not cited.

D4: no pinned commit SHA for haedal-protocol-interface (read via search body only). The repo holds the interface only, and the Move source and any deployment artifacts were not inspected. The haedal-skill repo (hasui/hawal/vehaedal skills) was seen only in a snippet and may contain further package/object IDs.
D4: the Sui AdminCap/UpgradeCap holder, the package publisher, and the owners of the Staking object were not identified. Who can upgrade the packages is unknown.
D5: chain Sui: addresses surfaced from docs tokenomics, GitHub README and the Navi SDK, but no explorer confirmation.
D6: no factory or enumerable children identified. The Sui chain is not supported by the read API.
D7: all actor_class values are 'unknown' because object ownership and package bytecode were not read.

D8: snippet-only sightings not placed in admin_addresses: the BNB Smart Chain HAEDAL token 0x3d9be0ac1001cd81c32464276d863d2ffdca4967 (holder.io and CoinGecko search snippets, outside the pinned chain list); an earlier snippet showed a shorter vesting list, which is superseded by the fetched page.

D8: the Navi SDK default package 0x19e6ea7f5ced4f090e20da794cc80349a03e638940ddb95155a4e301f5f4967c is recorded as role 'other' with unverified relationship to Haedal's own packages. It may be a different or newer Haedal package or an integration.
D2: bug bounty page (security/bug-bounty.md), governance forum and security contact were listed or implied but not fetched. protocol_metadata for those fields is null.
D2: veHAEDAL, HMM (deprecated per docs index since August 2026) and haWAL contracts were not located.

protocol_metadata.about: Haedal is a liquid staking protocol on Sui. Users stake SUI and receive haSUI, a yield-bearing liquid staking token that can be used elsewhere in Sui DeFi. The protocol also offers haWAL for staking Walrus (WAL) tokens, and a HAEDAL governance token with a veHAEDAL lock. The docs index notes that its Haedal Market Maker (HMM) service has been deprecated since August 2026.
